objective: Frozen computation: the four- and five-distinction counts; growth to n = 14 under start-sharing, neighbour, random-earlier and states-only rules; an exhaustive check that the only single knots keeping a line are the two predicted ones, through m = 8.
status: Supported 2026-11-17 (referee pending): 8 of 8 frozen predictions held: start, states-only and spiral rules grow exact lines to n = 14 (28 states; ends found uniquely from the states at every step); the neighbour rule fails from n = 4 (2F(n+1), 1,220 at 14), random-earlier from 5 (456); exactly m + 1 single knots keep a line at m = 3..8, all betweenness (kinds read post hoc); 3x3 and 3x4 box betweenness: 10 and 12 states, d = 2 L1, betweenness = boxes.
title: Growth rules for an order made of knots
